summary: This sermon focuses on Jesus' post-resurrection appearance to his disciples in the locked room, emphasizing both the physical reality of the resurrection and the essential gospel truths he wanted them to grasp. The preacher uses water metaphors and an object lesson to illustrate different dimensions of relationship with the Holy Spirit, and concludes by connecting communion to the call to be chosen, blessed, broken, and given for God's purposes.
key_points: Jesus' physical resurrection is a non-negotiable essential doctrine
Core gospel essentials: Scripture fulfillment, the cross, resurrection, repentance and forgiveness, taking the gospel to all nations
Relationship with the Holy Spirit has multiple dimensions: conviction, filling/drinking, and immersion/baptism
We are chosen and blessed by God to be broken and given for his kingdom purposes
As the Father sent Jesus, so Jesus sends us
big_idea: Jesus physically rose from the dead, established essential gospel truths with his disciples, and commissions all believers to be filled with the Holy Spirit and sent into the world just as the Father sent him.
title: Resurrection Rumors: Emotions in Turmoil
